title: Picto Link Canonical Representation
description: Black-and-white Link-a-Pix grid. Some cells contain a positive integer clue whose value is the length of the path linking its pair; a value of 1 is a single standalone cell. Players link each pair with a non-crossing path of exactly that many cells; the filled cells reveal a picture (the grid need not be fully filled).

cells.description: m x n grid of integers. 0 = empty cell, any positive integer = a clue whose value is the path length. Values >= 2 appear an even number of times (matched into pairs); 1 is a standalone single cell. No upper limit.
